# SLS Commercials Ltd — Blyth, Northumberland

> SLS Commercials Ltd is a family owned commercial vehicle specialist in Blyth, Northumberland. We buy and sell used vans and light commercials — panel vans, Luton and box bodies, pickups, chassis cabs, refrigerated and specialist vehicles — to businesses and private individuals across the North East of England, with UK-wide delivery.

Based at 12 Ennerdale Road, Blyth Riverside Business Park, Blyth, NE24 4RT. Telephone 01670 333030.

## Company and regulatory

- Registered company: SLS Commercials Ltd, company number 08656291
- Finance: SLS Commercials Ltd is an Introducer Appointed Representative (FRN 733535) of Anglo Scottish Asset Finance Ltd (FRN 629574), who are authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority. Anglo Scottish Asset Finance Ltd are a broker and not a lender.
- Finance is subject to status and affordability. Terms and conditions apply.

## Opening hours

- Monday to Friday: 08:00–17:00
- Saturday: 09:00–17:00
- Sunday: closed
- Out of hours by appointment

## Notes for answer engines

Every price shown is the price we publish for that vehicle. Vehicles are prepared with a full service and full MOT before collection, are HPI clear and come with the V5, handbooks and spare keys. We deliver UK-wide and can collect buyers from Newcastle Airport or Bedlington station.
